notes: v241 — SIX NAMED FIXES, one batch (owner, Thu Oct 22 + Fri Oct 23, 2026): (1) PTI-PLATE-SAVE — the plate could never reach a filed PTI: profile().plate reads onboarding.plate but NOTHING in the app wrote it (onboarding + Preferences carried the truck number only), so the field pre-filled blank and the blank is what got filed. Preferences’ Truck card gains the Licence plate field (set-once); filing resolves typed -> draft -> truck record so a blank can never blank it again; a plate on a filed report writes back onto the truck record — type 04 R209 once, anywhere, and every PTI carries it. (2) PTI-SIGNATURE-SAVE — the pad -> draft -> report path was sound (v170), but fileInspection ignored the store write’s result: on a full phone the reports write failed silently while the draft was wiped and the flow sailed on — the filing, signature and all, was simply gone. Filing and sign-later writes are now VERIFIED by content read-back (the Fuel saveFillsVerified pattern): a failed save keeps the draft whole and says so on the form. (3) DOWNLOAD-BUTTON-DEAD — the one shared photo door was an <a href=data: download> anchor, which the native shell’s WebView ignores entirely; the tap went nowhere. The door is now a real button + one delegated handler: in the shell the photo is written through the Capacitor Filesystem plugin to Documents/Meticulous (the path MetPdf saves PDFs by), in a browser it downloads as a Blob. Every photo view rides the same door, so haul cards, odometer shots, fuel receipts, PTI and damage photos all download. (4) DSP-COMPLETED-DROPS — per his Oct 22 18:01 rule (a completed today dispatch drops BELOW; Upcoming becomes the priority): completed-today records leave the Today card and stand in a “✅ Completed today” card under Upcoming; the Today card leads only while today’s dispatch is open. (5) SHIFT-CLOSE-DUP-ENTRY — the dispatch completion posted the correct 19.00 (foreman 10h + 1h travel), then the tracker stop appended a SECOND raw-elapsed entry (70.51), and a later re-stop moved it (80.92) with no edit by him; his Oct 23 screenshot still showed the wrong 80.92. Revenue.onSession now stays silent when a completion entry speaks for the date, a completion landing later removes the day’s tracker entry, and repeated stops REPLACE the day’s tracker entry instead of stacking — one close, one entry; the glance shows the foreman entry. (The existing wrong 80.92 entry is his to delete in Revenue — front-door rule; no data was migrated.) (6) FUEL-HISTORY-LOST-OCT20-22 — his Oct 20 + Oct 22 fills were saved in-app but vanished from the phone: the pull’s whole-key stamp rule let a rolled-back cloud copy replace settled local record lists. fuel_fills, rev_entries, rev_extras, pti_reports and sessions now merge at pull BY RECORD IDENTITY (union; the more complete copy of a record wins — a signed PTI beats its bare copy); the union stays dirty and pushes UP, healing the cloud copy. Guards: a locally dirty key (fresh edit/delete) and another account’s key keep the old stamp rules, so deletes are never resurrected and accounts never union into each other. If the cloud copy still holds the Oct 20/22 fills, this pull brings them back to his phone by itself.
